title.ru: Past Perfect Continuous: предпрошедшее длительное время

summary.ru: (+) S + had been + V-ing · (–) S + had not been + V-ing · (?) Had + S + been + V-ing?
summary.en: (+) S + had been + V-ing · (–) S + had not been + V-ing · (?) Had + S + been + V-ing?

body.ru:
(+) **S + had been + V-ing** — утверждение
(–) **S + had not been + V-ing**
(?) **Had + S + been + V-ing?**
body.en:
(+) **S + had been + V-ing**
(–) **S + had not been + V-ing**
(?) **Had + S + been + V-ing?**

examples: She had been working all day.
They had not been waiting long.
We had been walking for hours.

body.ru:
• процесс **до** прошлого события
• длительность до момента в прошлом
• причина **видимого результата**
• подчёркиваем процесс, а **не** результат
• вопрос *how long* о длительности
body.en:
• a process **before** a past event
• duration up to a moment in the past
• the cause of a **visible result**
• emphasising the process, **not** the result
• a *how long* question about duration

examples: The ground was wet because it had been raining.
She had been waiting for an hour when the bus came.
How long had they been living there?
She had been painting the fence all afternoon.
exampleTranslations: Земля была мокрая, потому что шёл дождь.
Она ждала уже час, когда пришёл автобус.

body.ru:
• **for** + длительность
• **since** + начало
• **all day / all morning** (весь день / всё утро)
• **how long** (как долго)
• **before** + событие
• **when** + Past Simple
body.en:
• **for** + duration
• **since** + starting point
• **all day / all morning**
• **how long**
• **before** + an event
• **when** + Past Simple

examples: He had been driving for six hours.
They had been living there since 2018.
We had been working all morning.
exampleTranslations: Он вёл машину уже шесть часов.

explanation.ru: Continuous подчёркивает процесс, Past Perfect — результат, Past Continuous — процесс в прошлом, Past Simple — законченное действие.
explanation.en: The continuous stresses a process, the past perfect a result, the past continuous a past process, and the past simple a finished action.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.en: a visible result: the wet ground

pairs.right: The pavement was wet because it had been raining.

left.en: the cause of tiredness

pairs.right: She was exhausted because she had been working.

left.en: the cause of being late

pairs.right: He was late because he had been waiting for a bus.

left.en: the cause of the mess

pairs.right: The kitchen was a mess because they had been cooking.

explanation.ru: Past Perfect Continuous объясняет, какой процесс привёл к видимому результату в прошлом.
explanation.en: The past perfect continuous explains which process led to a visible result in the past.

prompt.en: Match each situation with its example.

left.en: duration: five hours

pairs.right: They had been driving for five hours.

left.en: he had been studying since 2019

pairs.right: He had been studying since 2019.

left.en: a period: all day

pairs.right: We had been painting the house all day.

left.en: a question about how long someone had waited

pairs.right: How long had she been waiting for us?

explanation.ru: For называет длительность, since — начало, all day — период, how long — вопрос о времени.
explanation.en: For names a duration, since a starting point, all day a period, and how long a question about time.

prompt.en: Match each meaning with its example.

left.ru: она писала романы годами до того, как стала знаменитой
left.en: she had been writing novels for years before she became famous

pairs.right: She had been writing novels for years before she became famous.

left.ru: к 2010 году она написала два романа
left.en: by 2010 she had written two novels

pairs.right: She had written two novels by 2010.

left.ru: она писала роман, когда я её встретил
left.en: she was writing a novel when I met her

pairs.right: She was writing a novel when I met her.

left.ru: в прошлом месяце она написала рассказ
left.en: last month she wrote a short story

pairs.right: She wrote a short story last month.

explanation.ru: Continuous подчёркивает процесс, Past Perfect — результат, Past Continuous — процесс в прошлом, Past Simple — факт.
explanation.en: The continuous stresses a process, the past perfect a result, the past continuous a past process, and the past simple a fact.

prompt.en: Match each situation with its example.

left.ru: общий вопрос: шёл ли дождь до того, как ты проснулся

pairs.right: Had it been raining before you woke up?

left.ru: как долго они там жили до переезда

pairs.right: How long had they been living there?

left.ru: чем ты занимался всё послеобеденное время
left.en: what you had been doing all afternoon

left.ru: почему она плакала до нашего прихода
left.en: why she had been crying before we came

pairs.right: Why had she been crying?

explanation.ru: В вопросах had и been идут в начале, вопросительное слово — первым.
explanation.en: In questions had and been come first, and the question word comes first of all.

pairs.right: He had been learning German before he moved to Berlin.
